name: Tabs
description: A row of tabs that switch between panels of content in one place: a list of tab labels above a rule, with the current tab marked by a heavier underline and a bolder, darker label. This contract records the alternate tab style designed for az-digital/design#170, which gives the current tab stronger emphasis than Arizona Bootstrap's existing nav-tabs style. A tab is at rest, current, or disabled.
sources: az-digital/design#170: add an alternate tab style variant
Figma branch tab-design-issue-170 of the AZ Digital UX Design System, Tabs page, Tabs component (node 6190:73): the alternate style's colors, type, spacing and underline weights
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2240 (approved): Garamond Premier Pro is the serif typeface, which the Figma design uses for the tab labels
Arizona Bootstrap 5.3.x underline tabs (scss/override/_nav.scss, scss/override/_variables.scss): the resting and disabled label colors, which the Figma design matches
az-digital/design#194 review: the label's line-height is az.line-height.base (42px), for consistency with the design system's shared tokens; the Figma design was updated to match

root.description: The tab set: the tab list and the rule beneath it. The rule runs the full width, and each tab's own underline sits on top of it, so the current tab reads as joined to its panel.

list.description: The row of tabs, laid out left to right above the rule.

gap.$description: Space between tabs, so labels read as separate targets. Not a step on az.spacing: the scale has no 44px step.

tab.description: One tab: its label, padding and underline. At rest the label is Azurite with no underline of its own. Hover and keyboard focus are not yet designed; see az-digital/design#170.

padding.y.$description: Tab top and bottom padding. The same value as az.spacing.2, kept as the component's own value so the tab's height can change without moving the spacing scale.

padding.x.$description: Tab left and right padding. Not a step on az.spacing: the scale goes 8px then 16px.

border.bottom.width.$description: A disabled tab has no underline of its own: it can't become the current tab.

label.description: The tab's text: a serif face, larger than body text, so the tab row reads as a heading-level wayfinding element.

font.size.$description: Tab label text size. The same value as az.font-size.h3, kept as the component's own value because it is a tab's size, not a heading level.

state.description: Which tab this is in the row. With none chosen, a tab is at rest; a tab that can't be chosen uses the disabled state instead of an option here.

current.description: The tab whose panel is showing: a heavier Blue underline and a bold Blue label. Arizona Bootstrap marks it .active with aria-selected="true".

border.bottom.width.$description: The current tab's underline weight, heavier than the rule beneath the row so it reads as selected. Not az.border.width.md (2px), which the rule uses; the border scale has no 4px step.
